_fork_note: denisvmiheev/ai_rules_1c fork: default server set matches an EDT-based workflow (edt-mcp) plus v8std-local for ITS standards, instead of upstream's classic docker distribution (1c-code-metadata-mcp, 1c-syntax-checker-mcp, 1c-graph-metadata-mcp, 1c-code-check-mcp, 1c-data-mcp — dropped from this catalog; restore from git history if a project needs the classic distribution instead). See content/skills/mcp-1c-tools/docs/edt-mcp.md for the capability mapping. edt-mcp itself needs no license key or docker container — it ships with 1C:EDT (https://github.com/DitriXNew/EDT-MCP) and just needs EDT running with the plugin enabled.

servers.description: 1C:EDT MCP plugin: metadata discovery & typed mutation, BSL read/write & navigation, call hierarchy / impact analysis, EDT validation markers, forms rendering, debug & YAXUnit & profiling, infobases / DB update, event log, git branches, translation
1C platform documentation (docsearch, docinfo), project development standards (standards) and file-format specifications (formatspec)
Code templates library, implementation examples search, and project vector memory (remember/recall)
Standard Subsystems Library (БСП / SSL) function search
Read-only v8std.ru mirror: ITS 1C development standards search, and mapping between analyzer diagnostics (ACC/АПК, BSLLS, EDT, v8-code-style) and the standard clauses they enforce
